1  *****
 The Police Inspector of Basavangudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 and 5 for the offence punishable U/s.498(A) 506 & Sec.3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
 2.
The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt.Sunitha.
The gist of the prosecution case is that complainant got married accused No.1 on 19-06-2014.

At the time of marriage, as per the demand of accused persons, the parents of the complainant had given Rs.Five lakhs cash, 80 gms. of gold and one Kg. of silver to the accused No.1 and 250 gms. of gold ornaments to the complainant.

After the marriage when complainant was residing with accused persons, at the instigation of other accused persons, accused No.1 was not taking care of the complainant and used to abuse her in foul and filthy language.

When complainant got pregnant, accused persons forced complainant to bring Rs.Five lakhs as dowry from her paternal house and threatened her, if she does not bring the same, she would be set ablaze by pouring kerosene.
The accused No.1 left complainant at Kanakapura bus stand and went away.
When  3  C.C.No.17311/2017 complainant was hospitalized for delivery, accused No.1 did not visit complainant and her child.
The accused No.1 did not take the complainant and his child to his house.

When complainant called accused No.1 to take her to his house, accused No.1 demanded Rs.Five lakhs and threatened her to do away with her life, if she does not bring dowry and thereby accused No.1 and 5 caused Sunitha vs Suresh Kumar on 15 February, 2024

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21582506/
2 physical and mental cruelty to the complainant.
Based on the information of Smt.Sunitha a case in Cr.No.50/2016 came to be registered against the accused No.1 to 6 for the aforesaid offences .
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I. of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet only against accused No.1 and 5 for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused No.1 and 5 entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused No.1 and 5 as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.
The Accused No.5 was reported dead and case against him stood abated as per order dated 11-10-2021.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 and after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was  4  C.C.No.17311/2017 sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused No.1 in the language known to him, to which, the accused No.1 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5 . In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 & P.2 documents

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused No.1, the recording of Statement of Accused No.1 as Sunitha vs Suresh Kumar on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21582506/
3 required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused No.1 caused physical and mental  cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry and  threatened complainant to do away with her life and  thereby accused No.1 has committed the offences  punishable U/s.498(A), 506 R/w/s.34 of IPC. & Sec.3 &
4 of Dowry Prohibition Act?
 2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.

As per final order, for the following:
 R E A SON S  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1, the prosecution has examined complainant Smt. Sunitha as PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P.2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement and Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

10. PW-1 in her examination-in-chief deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 19-06-2014 and after the marriage, accused persons looked after her well and deposed accused persons did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and did not threatened her with dire consequences.

PW-1 deposed that there was petty Sunitha vs Suresh Kumar on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21582506/
4 quarrel between her and accused persons in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station, there the police have took her signature on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused persons have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.

Though PW-1 was cross examined by the prosecution,
nothing worth could be elicited.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness has turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.
In view of the material witness, turning hostile the prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the Negative.

The bail bond of accused No.1 shall be in force for a period of 6 months.
